methodology: One adjacent run pair on the same environment using identical synthetic input. Includes parser/model JavaScript work and timer-backed cooperative yield overhead; excludes disk I/O and DOM/Canvas rendering. Not a statistically controlled multi-run measurement.
limitations: Results can vary with system load and runtime state.
This is a focused Section Graph microbenchmark, not end-to-end application performance.
The measurement does not validate Canvas rendering, layout worker performance, real filesystem access, or Windows Tauri runtime behavior.
